name: Starlight Harp
source:
Shuji works at the detective agency. His current case is strangely connected with the WISH music therapy that his parents develop to deal with viruses.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]

修司在一家偵探事務所工作。他正在調查的案子，竟與父母為了對抗病毒而開發的WISH音樂療法有著奇妙聯繫。
